footnotes.footnote: Joshua Schmidt, a designated director of one or more affiliates of the Reporting Person, received a grant of Common Stock in consideration for services rendered and agreed to be rendered as a member of the Board of Directors of the Issuer (the "Board"). Upon receipt by Mr. Schmidt, the shares of Common Stock were transferred, in part, to Juniper Capital III PED Holdings, LLC ("Fund III Holdings").

The shares of restricted Common Stock were issued to Mr. Schmidt pursuant to the Issuer's 2021 Equity Incentive Plan and are subject to forfeiture. The shares vest at the rate of (i) 25% of the shares on the three (3) month anniversary of October 31, 2026; (ii) 25% on the six (6) month anniversary of October 31, 2026; (iii) 25% on the nine (9) month anniversary of October 31, 2026; and (iv) 25% on the twelve (12) month anniversary of October 31, 2026, subject to Mr. Schmidt's continued service on the Board on such vesting dates, and subject to the terms and conditions of a Restricted Shares Grant Agreement entered into by and between the Issuer and an affiliate of the Reporting Person. Exempt from Section 16(b) pursuant to Rule 16b-3.

The Reporting Person may be deemed to have voting and dispositive power over such securities by virtue of its general partner interest in Juniper Capital III, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership and investment fund that wholly owns and controls Fund III Holdings. The Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of the securities except to the extent of its pecuniary interest therein.

Edward Geiser, a designated director of one or more affiliates of the Reporting Person, received a grant of Common Stock in consideration for services rendered and agreed to be rendered as a member of the Board. Upon receipt by Mr. Geiser, the shares of Common Stock were transferred, in part, to Fund III Holdings.

The shares of restricted Common Stock were issued to the Reporting Person pursuant to the Issuer's 2021 Equity Incentive Plan and are subject to forfeiture. The shares vest at the rate of (i) 25% of the shares on the three (3) month anniversary of February 27, 2027; (ii) 25% on the six (6) month anniversary of February 27, 2027; (iii) 25% on the nine (9) month anniversary of February 27, 2027; and (iv) 25% on the twelve (12) month anniversary of February 27, 2027, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service on the Board on such vesting dates, and subject to the terms and conditions of a Restricted Shares Grant Agreement entered into by and between the Issuer and an affiliate of the Reporting Person. Exempt from Section 16(b) pursuant to Rule 16b-3.
